# TechPlay

> TechPlay is a gaming portal covering hardware reviews, gaming news, esports, game database, and community discussions. Based in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

## Content Sections

- [News](/news) — Latest gaming and tech news
- [Reviews](/reviews) — In-depth hardware and game reviews with expert ratings
- [Hardware](/hardware) — PC hardware analysis, benchmarks, and buying guides
- [Guides](/guides) — Gaming guides, tutorials, and tips
- [Games Database](/games) — Database of 1M+ games with specs and release dates
- [Videos](/videos) — Video content and streams
- [Forum](/forum) — Community discussions and threads
- [Calendar](/calendar) — Gaming release calendar and events
